entities.name: CLI beta-blocker outcomes
observations: Retrospective NSQIP CLI revascularization cohort (2011–2014; 11,785 infrainguinal cases) associated beta-blocker use with adjusted 30-day MACE (OR 1.27, p=0.03) and MI (OR 1.36, p=0.03), but not mortality (OR 1.22, p=0.19) or MALE (OR 0.99, p=0.88); MALE included patency loss, reintervention, or amputation.
The analysis included 4,377 endovascular procedures, but adjusted estimates were reported across revascularization modalities; observational design and confounding limit causal inference.

entities.name: CLTI EVT evidence limits
observations: Available CLTI endovascular cohorts did not report beta-blocker-specific limb outcome estimates; absence of a reported association is not proof of no effect.
Evidence does not justify routine beta-blocker discontinuation solely due to CLI or endovascular therapy; weigh cardiac indication and individual perioperative risks.
